theme.label: Appearance theme

experimental.warning: Experimental features may contain bugs or be partially unavailable. Turning a switch off hides its entry immediately.

blueprint.label: Blueprint
blueprint.hint: Show the blueprint workbench entry. Turning off hides the title-bar switcher and the workbench.
blueprint.note: Project documents must follow the Note format. Maintain them through WorkflowX or Note MCP.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.hint: The former engineering knowledge entry has been retired. Blueprint now provides project documents and review.
knowledge.note: This entry is no longer offered separately; Persona has its own toggle.

roundtable.label: Roundtable
roundtable.hint: Show the roundtable view in the island expanded stage. Turning off hides the entry; ongoing discussions are unaffected.
roundtable.note: Configure a working global default model first. Check discussion results before adopting them.

persona.label: Persona
persona.hint: Enable personal memory and profile. Turning off stops personal capture, processing and chat recall while retaining data.
persona.note: Detailed settings control capture, inferred project habits, chat recall and retention.

remoteControl.label: Remote collaboration
remoteControl.hint: Enable Android QR pairing and remote Claude Code terminals. Turning off hides the entry, disconnects the phone and stops the remote service while desktop terminals keep running.
remoteControl.note: Devices require desktop approval. Uses direct UDP without a business relay; some networks may not connect.

teamCollab.label: Team collaboration
teamCollab.hint: Show the sidebar team row, the first-run login gate, and the team page in Settings. Turning off hides the entries; login state and org data are kept and restored on re-enable.
teamCollab.note: Basic account and organization management is available. Cross-device project and document sync is not yet complete.

desktop.label: Enable desktop notifications
desktop.hint: Notify via system notification center after Agent terminal tasks finish.

onComplete.label: Notify on completion
onComplete.hint: Successfully completed Agent sessions notify after the runtime threshold.

onFailure.label: Notify on failure
onFailure.hint: Failure notifications are independently controlled for higher-priority alerts.

includeErrorMessage.label: Include short error message
includeErrorMessage.hint: Long or noisy Agent output is truncated before entering system notifications.

remote.label: Enable remote notifications
remote.hint: Send alerts to enabled remote channels on completion, failure, or pending action.

remoteComplete.label: Send on completion
remoteComplete.hint: Successfully completed Agent sessions send via remote threshold.

remoteFailure.label: Send on failure
remoteFailure.hint: Failure events send immediately, bypassing the completion toggle.

remoteAttention.label: Send on pending action
remoteAttention.hint: Attention events waiting for authorization or input send to remote channels.

remoteApproval.label: Send on approval request
remoteApproval.hint: Authorization requests send as a distinct type for future approval buttons.

feishu.label: Enable Feishu notifications
feishu.hint: Use a Feishu group robot webhook or a custom app (app_id/app_secret) to send card messages.

feishuControl.label: Enable Feishu bidirectional control
feishuControl.hint: App mode only; message and signed card actions only accept whitelisted open_ids.

completeThreshold.label: Notify after terminal runs for
completeThreshold.hint: Set to 0 seconds to notify on every completed Agent task.

remoteCompleteThreshold.label: Remote completion threshold
remoteCompleteThreshold.hint: Only applies to completion events; failure and pending send immediately.

dedupeWindow.label: Deduplication window
dedupeWindow.hint: The same event will not be sent twice to the same provider within this window.

sendTimeout.label: Send timeout
sendTimeout.hint: Provider fails after timeout without blocking local notification flow.

feishuMode.label: Send mode
feishuMode.hint: Webhook for group robots; App for custom apps sending to chat/open_id.

receiveIdType.label: Receive ID Type
receiveIdType.hint: Target ID type, must match the receive_id below.

allowedOpenIds.label: Allowed operator open_ids
allowedOpenIds.hint: One ou_... per line; empty, invalid, and duplicate values are removed on save.

groupPromptPrefix.label: Group chat prompt prefix
groupPromptPrefix.hint: Group chats must @mention the robot or use this non-reserved /name prefix.

bindingTtl.label: Binding validity
bindingTtl.hint: Feishu-session-to-terminal bindings expire automatically after this duration.

cardActionTtl.label: Card action validity
cardActionTtl.hint: Signed buttons cannot be used after this time.

auditRetentionDays.label: Audit retention period
auditRetentionDays.hint: Companion audit JSONL records older than this are cleaned up.

maxFollowUpLength.label: Max follow-up length
maxFollowUpLength.hint: Prompts exceeding this limit are rejected before submitting to the terminal.

appId.label: App ID
appId.hint: Feishu Open Platform custom app app_id.

appSecret.label: App Secret
appSecret.hint: Leave blank to keep the saved secret; a new value replaces it.

notification.controlNotice: Webhook supports notifications only. Direct text must bind a terminal first; group chats must @mention the robot or use a prefix. Remote control never exposes an arbitrary shell.

error.controlUnavailable: Unable to read Feishu control status

enable.label: Enable knowledge recording
enable.hint: When enabled, JanusX writes hook-driven Agent conversations and task events into the current workspace knowledge base.

autoAccept.label: Auto-accept high-confidence deterministic facts
autoAccept.hint: Off by default. When on, tool/checkpoint facts with confidence ≥ 0.9 skip the Inbox and apply directly (audited as auto-policy).

boundary.label: Capture boundary
boundary.hint: AI terminal records rely only on hook lifecycle events, never raw terminal input. Disabling notifications does not disable background hook processing.

mode.label: Processing mode
mode.hint: Rules always produce review candidates. Refinement runs only when an available decision model requests it; otherwise candidates stay in the Inbox for review.

mcp.notBuilt: Not built yet: run npm run build to generate the MCP entry.
mcp.saved: Written to {{path}}. Restart the terminal to take effect.

default.label: Default approval mode
default.hint: New Agent sessions inherit this mode. You can switch the active Janus Chat session directly.

maxSteps.label: Max loop steps
maxSteps.hint: Allowed range is 1 to 100, default 40. Prefer background commands for long builds.

safeCompile.label: Auto-allow safe compile commands
safeCompile.hint: When off, package-manager build/check commands also require per-action approval. Risky commands always require approval.

agent.safety: Auto-run still enforces workspace boundaries, sensitive-path denial, input validation, checkpoints and audit records.
